key_insight: VoroTypes automatically enumerates all Voronoi cell topologies a crystal can exhibit under small perturbations, enabling robust structural identification for complex crystals beyond a few simple reference lattices.
engineering_relevance: It expands atomistic simulation analysis to complex phases like Frank–Kasper and Laves structures, with per-sublattice resolution and direct integration into VoroTop and OVITO workflows.
method: Takes CIF or POSCAR crystal inputs and computes the full family of Voronoi topologies.
Uses exact symmetry reduction to remove redundant cases and speed up enumeration.
Applies validity pruning to discard impossible topologies and exports the result as a VoroTop filter.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a pre-computed library of filters covering over a thousand Materials Project structures, indicating broad structural coverage and deployment readiness.
watch_item: Performance and correctness depend on the quality of the crystallographic input and on the assumption of small generic perturbations, so atypical distortions may fall outside the enumerated filter.
paper_title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
